question: Should this issue remain the canonical first-class timeline UI/CLI follow-up after the metadata audit foundation, or should maintainers fold the timeline scope into the broader audit/subagent lifecycle issues?
rationale: The code already has several source signals and partial views, but choosing the durable owner, redaction model, authorization boundary, and public UI/CLI shape requires maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Use audit foundation, keep timeline follow-up
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 as the durable metadata foundation and keep this issue for the approved first-class timeline surfaces after that contract exists.

options.title: Fold into lifecycle supervision
options.body: Move the remaining timeline requirements under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38626 if maintainers want subagent lifecycle supervision to own the user-visible timeline.

options.title: Defer standalone timeline
options.body: Leave only Activity and trajectory tooling for now and close or defer this feature until operator demand is clearer.

recommendation.title: Use audit foundation, keep timeline follow-up
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 as the durable metadata foundation and keep this issue for the approved first-class timeline surfaces after that contract exists.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the related metadata-audit direction and has recent state/lifecycle history that the timeline contract would depend on.
